mapper.select: select m.id as id, m.parent_id as parent_id, m.create_time as create_time, m.title as title, m.level as level, m.sort as sort, m.name as name, m.icon as icon, m.is_hidden as is_hidden from role_menu_relation rmr left join menu m on rmr.menu_id = m.id where rmr.role_id = #{roleId} and m.id is not null group by m.id

SELECT m.id as id, m.parent_id as parentId, m.create_time as createTime, m.title as title, m.level as level, m.sort as sort, m.name as name, m.icon as icon, m.is_hidden as is_hidden FROM admin_role_relation arr LEFT JOIN role r ON arr.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN role_menu_relation rmr ON r.id = rmr.role_id LEFT JOIN menu m ON rmr.menu_id = m.id WHERE arr.admin_id = #{adminId} AND m.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.id
